Definition: to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate
BiblicalUsage: Yâtsath means to kindle a fire, to set something burning. Josiah's men were told the wrath of the LORD was kindled against Judah, and Absalom's servants set Joab's barley field on fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fire of God's wrath is kindled by a people's disobedience, and Joab's field was the warning.
